To report a case, you will need to provide accurate and relevant information. You can also upload media files as evidence to support your report. Once your report has been received, you will be contacted with the next steps in the process.
Once you report a case, you can track its status and progress as it moves toward resolution. This helps keep you informed and updated throughout the process.

If you are a victim of Gender-Based Violence (GBV) and experiencing trauma, you can use some of our wellness exercises as an initial step toward emotional support and recovery. However, we strongly recommend seeking help from a qualified wellness or mental health professional for proper care and guidance.
You’re not currently logged into an account. Tap the **Continue** button to log in and gain access to all the features of the app.
We have compiled a few resources about GBV, to help you learn more about it and to help you make the right decisions.
